sourceMaterial.exclusions: Do not assume the Squad should own product strategy. A bounded delivery focus may be appropriate where strategy is translated clearly elsewhere.
sourceMaterial.testScenario: PO selected Shaping Product Strategy and Optimising Product Portfolio Value; Squad selected Working Within Team Boundaries and Delivering Output. Contrast with Squad selected Delivering Meaningful Outcomes.
sourceMaterial.expectedInterpretation: Possible gap between strategic product direction and the context the Squad uses to organise delivery. Ask whether the Squad can explain how its work contributes to the broader product direction.
